name: Accursed Cargo (3-4)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
description: A wooden crate bearing a chthonic sigil glows with a power contained within it.
disable: DC 22 Thievery (trained) to open the crate with gradual release of its magical energy, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to dispel the rune

offensiveAbilities.name: Planar Depressurization
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the sigil on the crate

Effect The incomplete demonic pact causes the crate to explode. Bits of wood and energy from the Outer Rifts deal (2d8+5) Bludgeoning Damage] damage to all creatures within 10 feet of it (Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw).
